Printed edition: Salmonia : or, Days of fly fishing, in a series of conversations, with some account of the habits of fishes belonging to the genus Salmo, Philadelphia : Carey & Lea, 1832, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/davysalmonia00davyrich.
